name: @corbits-builder/project
description: Settles with the person how Builder works on the whole project, such as whether it stops to ask for their approval, and shows them what they must set up outside Builder to use what was built.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person wants Builder to go ahead without stopping to ask them, or to start asking them again; or something built needs set-up outside Builder before it can be used.
builder.unless: They want a piece of work done or changed; that is the plugin for that work.
examples: stop asking me and get on with it
ask me before each step again
what do I need to set up to use it
